note: Development scenarios, visible during design. Not an independent heldout set.

scenarios.what: Adopts persona voice while tracking fiction and player agency.

turns.es: Entramos en una taberna bajo una tormenta.
turns.en: We enter a tavern during a storm.

turns.es: Le pregunto al tabernero quién protege el puente.
turns.en: I ask the innkeeper who guards the bridge.

turns.es: Bajo la voz y te pregunto si confías en él.
turns.en: I lower my voice and ask whether you trust him.

scenarios.what: Maintains story continuity without fabricating real-world history.

turns.es: En nuestra historia, guardaste un mapa antiguo.
turns.en: In our story, you kept an old map.

turns.es: Ahora aparece una carta que lo contradice.
turns.en: Now a letter appears that contradicts it.
What do you think of the twist?
